summary: Vilhelm Thomsen was a scholar of linguistics and Iranian and Central Asian studies. Educated at Randers State School and the University of Copenhagen (PhD 1869), he served at Copenhagen as Privatdozent (1869), associate professor (1875), and professor (1887–1913).

Vimla Karnatak is an Indology and philosophy scholar who studied under Gajanan Shastri Musalgaonkar. She served as Professor and Head of the Department of Sanskrit at Banaras Hindu University (attested 2000).

Vinay Lal is a historian and Indologist who studied at Johns Hopkins University (~1984–1986). Around 1993, he became a professor in the Department of History and Asian American Studies at the University of California, Los Angeles.

Vincenc Lesný worked in Indology, Buddhist studies, and Iranian and Central Asian studies. He studied at Charles University (~1903–1907) under Moriz Winternitz and Josef Zubatý, later holding a post at Charles University from ~1918 to 1952.

Vincent Arthur Smith was a historian and Indologist who earned a doctorate from Trinity College Dublin (~1867–1919). He served in the Bengal and Indian Civil Service (1871–1900) and later at the University of Oxford and its Indian Institute (~1910–1920).

Vincent Breugem specializes in Japanology and Buddhist studies. He studied under Lucia Dolce, attended Taisho, Kyoto, and Hanazono Universities, and completed his MA (1996) and PhD (2012) at Leiden University, where he was a research fellow in 2012.

Vincent Eltschinger works in Buddhist studies, Indology, and philosophy. Educated at Lausanne (PhD 2003 under Tom Tillemans) and Vienna (Habilitation ~2007–2014), he served at the Institute for the Cultural and Intellectual History of Asia and the EPHE (~2015).

Vincent Goossaert is a scholar of sinology and religious studies who studied under Kristofer Schipper (~1993–1997). He held posts at the CNRS (~1998–2012), CUHK (2007), and the École Pratique des Hautes Études (~2012).

Vincent Lefèvre specializes in Indology and archaeology. He studied under Bruno Dagens, attended the École Nationale des Chartes, obtained his Habilitation from Sorbonne Nouvelle University (2007), and served as a curator at the Guimet Museum.

Vincent Tournier specializes in Buddhist studies and Indology. He studied under Seishi Karashima and Cristina Scherrer-Schaub, earning his PhD from the EPHE (2012). His posts include the EFEO (attested 2021) and the University of Tokyo (attested 2026).

Vincenzo Vergiani is a scholar of Indology and linguistics who studied under Raffaele Torella (~1995–2001). He held positions at the University of Cambridge as Professor of Sanskrit (~2010) and as project head (~2011–2015).
Virendra Kumar Varma is an Indology and linguistics scholar who studied under traditional teachers Ramnath Dixit and Gopal Chandra Mishra, and later taught Kamala Prasad Tripathi.
Virendra Kumar Verma is a scholar in Indology and linguistics. He studied under Ramanatha Dikshita and Gopal Chandra Mishra, and taught Kamala Prasad Mishra.

Virendra Nath Misra was an archaeology and Indology scholar. He studied at the University of Lucknow (~1953–1957) and Savitribai Phule Pune University (~1958–1961), later serving as Director of the Deccan College Post-Graduate and Research Institute (~1981–2000).

Vishnu Sitaram Sukthankar was an Indologist who studied at St. Xavier's, Edinburgh, and Berlin (doctorate 1921) under Heinrich Lüders, Hermann Jacobi, and Moriz Winternitz. He served in the Archaeological Survey of India and at the Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute.

Vishva Bandhu was an Indologist and linguist. He served as Founder-Principal of Dayanand Brahma Mahavidyalaya (1921), Director of Dayanand Anglo-Vedic College (1934), and long-time Director of the Vishveshvaranand Vedic Research Institute (~1934–1973).

Vishvanath Narayan Mandlik was an Indologist and historian educated at Elphinstone College (~1847–1852). He served as an examiner at the University of Mumbai and as Vice-President of the Asiatic Society of Mumbai (~1874–1889).
Vishwa Nath Pathak was an Indologist and historian who studied under Arthur Llewellyn Basham. He held a professorship at Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gorakhpur University (attested 1973–1987).

Vishwanath Prasad Varma is a scholar of philosophy and Indology. He studied under Dhirendra Mohan Datta, Ganga Nath Bhattacharya, Joachim Wach (1950), and doctoral supervisor Kali Kinkar Datta (~1945–1950).

Vishwanathan Venkatachalam was an Indologist educated at Madras, Nagpur, and Vikram universities. He held posts at Vikram University, headed the Scindia Oriental Institute (~1972–1985), and served as vice-chancellor of Sampurnanand Sanskrit University and Kameshwar Singh Darbhanga Sanskrit University.
